title: No transparent concept of phenomenal bonding is available

statements.text: Physics yields only mathematico-causal structure, phenomenal bonding is not a mathematico-causal relation, and introspection reaches only one subject, so relations between subjects as subjects cannot be observed. Accepting bonding therefore brings a kind of mysterianism about how subjects combine.

sources.quote: physics, yields understanding only of the world's mathematico-causal structure, and the phenomenal bonding relation is not a mathematico-causal relation
There is a sense in which embracing this solution to the combination problem leads to a kind of mysterianism.
